fixed_editorial_15.provenance_boundary: The fixed 15 are editorial and pre-existing; they were not optimized or altered.

canonical_pca_reproduction.basis_source: reconstructed from all 275 canonical mean-pooled Qwen role vectors and sign-aligned to geometry_viz_data.json

integrity.pca_feature_variables: 5,120 coordinates of each mean-pooled role activation vector
integrity.role_mean_pooling: Each saved 2D tensor is averaged over its first dimension.

trait_cosine_matrix_reproduction.construction: mean each stored tensor over its first dimension, L2-normalize, role @ trait.T

integrity.trait_mean_pooling: Each saved 2D tensor is averaged over its first dimension.

interpretation: Optimized real traits have a large compact-k advantage, while a sufficiently large generic basis also approaches the full-bank reconstruction.

pca_trait_dependency.algebraic_dependence: Targets and predictors are different projections of the same mean-pooled Qwen role activation vectors; cosine predictors additionally divide by role norm.

redundancy.group_rule: Complete-linkage clustering of distance 1-abs(Pearson r), cut at 0.10 and 0.05.

role_norm_audit.interpretive_rule: Small norm CV supports cosine-as-scaled-linear-projection; material norm-PC association qualifies that approximation.

validation_design.feature_selection: At each step evaluate every remaining trait and every Ridge alpha using inner CV; outer-test rows remain untouched.
validation_design.inner: 4-fold shuffled KFold inside each outer training partition
validation_design.outer: 5-fold shuffled KFold repeated across 10 deterministic seeds
